input.summary: Settled 23 of 35 controls. Jump/Dash/Talk/Pause primaries (kb_c, kb_x, kb_escape, Y, X, B) bound to their clearly dominant sip/puff choices (evidenced). Grab/climb (kb_z, kb_left_shift) bound to their most-used puff sensors but set to a continuous 'normal' function rather than their usual tap, since Celeste's climb needs a sustained hold (evidenced input, adapted function). The four redundant gamepad grab inputs (triggers/bumpers) and 'start' mirror those evidenced choices since no separate history exists for them (inferred). Asked about 12 controls (back, quick_restart_controller, kb_a, kb_e, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_control, kb_q, kb_s, kb_w, mouse_right_button) because Celeste's sourced control list shows no function for them and there is no usage history to lean on.
